1.h: Kill 1000 centaurs.A few more centaur herds are thinned out.

2.h: Kill 1,000 enemies using profession combinations with another player.Kills that involved at least one profession combo with another player.

3.h: Kill 1000 skritt.Scrape these scavengers off the surface of Tyria.

4.h: Kill 1000 harpies.Clip the wings of these she-beasts.

5.h: Kill 1000 drakes.Enough of these massive drakes on Tyria's massive plains.

6.h: Kill 1000 spiders.They should have used their eight legs to run away from tougher fighters.

7.h: Kill 1000 ambient creatures.If small things were meant to live, they'd have bigger teeth or faster feet.

8.h: Kill 1000 bandits.All criminals eventually meet a dark end.

9.h: Participate in 5,000 events.Always willing to lend a hand, or sword, for the common good. You go where the action is.

10.h:
Have 2,000,000 coins in the wallet at one time.Money is truly no object for you.
Title: Golden

11.h: Earn 1,000 hero points by completing hero challenges or by gaining a level with a level 80 character.Your range of skills is quite impressive.

13.h: Consume 100,000 drinks.Continuing a valiant battle against dehydration.

14.h:
Consume 800 items of food.No stranger to Tyrian cuisine.

Additional notes on this achievement available below.[1]

15.h: Transmute 30 items.Two helms really are better than one.

16.h: Kill 1000 skale.It's not polite to eat the dead.

17.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a staff.A staff has many uses—all deadly.

18.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a sword.A classic weapon that grows more effective in your hand.

19.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a dagger.A slim, elegant blade with so many uses.

20.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a longbow.Kill 'em before they reach you? Kill 'em before they see you!

21.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a[sic] axe.It's not the prettiest weapon in the armory, but it slices beautifully.

22.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a scepter.Nothing weaves a web of magic like a fine scepter.

23.h: Kill 1000 bats.Consider these winged rats cut down.

24.h: Kill 1000 crustaceans.Even the creatures in the deep aren't safe from harm.

25.h: Kill 1000 devourers.Devourers may be ugly, tough, and dangerous, but they're still prey for a skilled adventurer.

26.h: Kill 1000 dredge.Become the enemy of the collective by killing dredge.

27.h: Kill 1000 elementals.Fire, earth, lightning, water, and ice can't stand up to steel and magic.

28.h: Kill 1000 ettins.Just goes to show: two heads are not better than one.

29.h: Kill 1000 ghosts.Send the spirits into the Mists so they can rest in peace.

30.h: Kill 1000 fish.Gut the scaly swimmers to catch an achievement this big.

31.h: Kill 1000 giants.The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

32.h: Kill 1000 griffons.Hunting these formidable beasts has been a Tyrian pastime for centuries.

33.h: Kill 1000 grawl.They should have worshipped [sic] you. At least they'd still be alive.

34.h: Kill 1000 hostile hylek.Cull these aggressive amphibians.

35.h: Kill 1000 members of the Flame Legion.Smoke out Baelfire's minions, and show them what real power looks like.

36.h: Kill 1000 imps.Don't worry. Demon blood is easy to wash out.

37.h: Kill 1000 members of the Inquest.If they are so smart, how come they couldn't stop from getting killed?

39.h: Kill 1000 jotun.These creatures used to be powerful and great kings. Now, dead.

40.h: Kill 1000 krait.Make it safe to go back in the water.

42.h: Kill 1000 members of the Nightmare Court.Haunt these evil sylvari like a bad dream.

43.h: Kill 1000 ogres.Big and tough are only impressive if you're alive to show it off.

44.h: Kill 1000 oozes.Hit them in the right spot and they make cool patterns in the mud.

45.h: Kill 1000 pirates.The worst thing to happen to pirates since scurvy and sea monsters.

46.h: Kill 1000 plants.These leafy monsters are now mulch.

47.h: Kill 1000 raptors.These birds of prey have met their predator.

48.h: Kill 1000 skelk.These tricky hunters learned the hard way you were the most dangerous game.

49.h: Kill 1000 members of the Sons of Svanir.The only good ice dragon cultist is a dead ice dragon cultist.
l: members of the Sons of Svanir

50.h: Kill 1000 trolls.Even trolls can't stand such brutal onslaughts.

51.h: Kill 1000 wind riders.Tangling with you was the last stupid decision these smart creatures ever made.

52.h: Kill 1000 wurms.Slice these slimy things from top to bottom.

53.h: Kill 1000 members of Zhaitan's army.Zhaitan should have raised a better army.

54.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a short bow.You deliver pain from a distance.

55.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a mace.Blunt force trauma is your friend, and you enjoy sharing it with your enemies.

56.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a focus.Only fools see this as an ornament. Only a master knows how to channel magic through it.

57.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a greatsword.You know how to wield a finely crafted piece of forged brutality.

58.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a hammer.When you absolutely want to turn your foes into jelly, this is your weapon.

59.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a warhorn.The sound of death marches upon your enemy.

60.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a pistol.You dispense death from the palm of your hand.

61.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a rifle.You deftly mix precision and power with this two-handed weapon.

62.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a torch.Bringing light to the darkness–forcefully.

63.h: Deliver 5,000 killing blows with a shield.You know how to turn defense into offense.

64.h: Complete the human personal story step "Breaking the Blade", "The Commander", or "The Trial of Julius Zamon".Through valor and a thirst for justice, you earned Logan Thackeray's trust.

65.h: Complete the asura personal story step "Gadd's Last Gizmo", "Defusing the Problem", "Here, There, Everywhere", or "The Things We Do For Love".Your brains and brawn were tested, and you stopped an Inquest plot.
l: The Things We Do For Love

66.h: Complete the norn personal story step "Minotaur Rampant", "The Last of the Giant-Kings", or "The Wolf Havroun".Today, you proved your strength by stopping a threat to the lodge.

67.h: Complete the charr personal story step "Deadly Force", "Ghostbore Artillery", "Operation: Bulwark", or "Quick and Quiet".You brought heat to the Flame Legion.

68.h: Complete the sylvari personal story step "Beneath a Cold Moon", "Black Night, White Stag", "The Heart of Nightmare", or "The Knight's Duel".You were awakened in the Dream and beat back the nightmare threat.

69.h:
Complete the sylvari personal story step "A Vision of Darkness", "Eye of the Sun", "Shattered Light", or "Snuffing Out Embers".Some victories are bittersweet, but they're victories nonetheless.
Title: Valiant of the Wyld Hunt

70.h:
Complete the asura personal story step "Flash Flood", "Magnum Opus", or "Split Second".Your quick thinking and actions stopped an error in your past from causing disaster in the present.
Title: Snaff Savant

71.h:
Complete the charr personal story step "Dishonorable Discharge", "In the Ruins", "Sins of the Father", "Thicker Than Water", or "Tribunes in Effigy".You have faced down the past, proving once again your might and wits.
Title: Warband Legionnaire

72.h:
Complete the human personal story step "Ashes of the Past", "Liberation", or "The Ringmaster".You dealt with your past, and now you may join the world moving forward.
Title: Hero of Shaemoor

73.h:
Complete the norn personal story step "Preserving the Balance", "The Championship Fight", or "The Machine in Action".You cleaved an embarrassment from your past.
Title: Slayer of Issormir

74.h: Complete the asura personal story step "A Meeting of the Minds", "Lines of Communication", or "Rakt and Ruin".Despite a setback, you find yourself ready to embark on a larger adventure.

75.h: Complete the charr personal story step "Ever Vigilant", "Research and Destroy", or "Whispers of Vengeance".Your honor is restored. However, you must prepare for a greater danger.

76.h: Complete the human personal story step "Kellach's Attack", "The Queen's Justice", or "The Trap".You saved Queen Jennah from an insidious plot.

77.h: Complete the norn personal story step "Assault the Hill", "Sever the Head", or "Silent Warfare".You destroyed the Dredge weapon and brought a fellow norn back on the path of destiny.

78.h: Complete the sylvari personal story step "A Tangle of Weeds", "Dead of Winter", or "Flower of Death".You made sure the dead stayed dead.

79.h: Complete the story step "Minister's Defense", or "Quaestor's Siege".You have become a full member of the Vigil.

80.h: Complete the story step "Attempted Deicide", "Evacuation", "Set To Blow", "The Lost Chieftain's Return", or "Unholy Grounds".You came to the aid of another race under threat by the dragons.

81.h: Complete the personal story step "Retribution".You liberated Claw Island from the undead and swore to strike back at the heart of Orr.

82.h: Complete the personal story step "A Sad Duty", "Delivering Justice", or "Liberating Apatia".You faced your worst fear and emerged triumphant.

83.h:
Complete the personal story step "Victory or Death".You are counted among the great heroes of Tyria.
Title: Pact Commander

84.h:
Collect 54 miniatures.Master of miniature mayhem.
Title: Mini Collector

6455.h:
Bring Albax lucky items from throughout Tyria by solving his riddles."Bring to me your world, for I have lost mine." —Albax
Objectives: 10 objectives in total
  • "The noble bird has been swept from solitude into the hands of chaos." Albax hinted at the monks of Shing Jea.
  • "The porcelain feline beckons you toward service in the name of the savory." Albax mentioned the smell of food in New Kaineng City.
  • "Bathed in gold and hubris, luck itself will lead you to me." Albax described a special room of games in Arborstone.
  • "In the sea of green, among the scaly ones, a relic lies with the mistakes of one's past." Albax gestured at the Jade Sea all around him.
  • "Brave the dead land to claim the foot of the swiftest." Albax pointed north, toward the Cursed Shore of Orr.
  • "Find the former walker of the blasted land, and gain a symbol of new growth." Albax shrugged while talking of the Branded landscape of the Iron Marches.
  • "In homes in pale parchment hills, find the form of an old survivor in the hands of a young one." Albax smiled, thinking of the rivers of Timberline Falls.
  • "In lush lands wracked with waste, ask for that which glitters in their patron's gaze." Albax's eyes opened wide picturing the dangers of Mount Maelstrom.
  • "A sacred weapon is held in the boughs of great trees, never to be turned against them." Albax spoke of the verdant sights of the Maguuma Jungle.
...
  • "The needy hold tight to a hope of plenty in a pitiless golden land." Albax cringed while thinking of the heat in the Crystal Desert.

  • Read the letter from Chief Inspector Lutze.

  • Lutze thinks there is a potential buyer among the elite of Divinity's Reach. Where do the rich like Lord Faren live again?
  • This is where the elite live; there must be something here.
  • You found a large amount of gold; looks like there is a note nearby.
  • The note ties Countess Cindy Breaud to the smuggling ring. Chief Inspector Lutze would like to see this.
  • Lutze thinks someone around Mantle's Arrival must be moving the organ crates around.
  • You found a crate of smuggled organs a charr was carrying, and it looks like there is a note nearby.
  • The note ties Saturninus Deepsmoke to the smuggling ring; Chief Inspector Lutze would like to see this.
  • Lutze's findings point toward a sylvari handling logistics. Question both suspects: Ylani and Isla.
  • You've talked to Ylani and Isla, but one is lying (or maybe both). Find a way to prove it.
  • Something about this report does not match up; it could have been doctored.
  • Something does not add up here. Return to Lutze once you figure out who is lying.
  • Lutze thinks there is a potential buyer around the docks in Lion's Arch.
  • The shipping manifests you found show Alden Wamser moving large sums of money. Interview him.
  • You've talked to Alden; it appears there is nothing suspicious about the money moving through Lion's Arch.
  • Lutze thinks some organs are making their way to Amnytas. You should poke around after helping the kodan destroy the titan organ sacs.
  • You've helped destroy some organs. Wait...is that someone hiding nearby?
  • You talked to Jaxi, but he gave nothing up. Maybe there is some evidence nearby?
  • The note ties Jaxi to the smuggling ring; Chief Inspector Lutze would like to see this.
  • You should talk to Chief Inspector Lutze about everything you found.
  • Lutze needs proof that the ringleader is Hedda the Cunning. Check out her former Lionguard post at Twinspur Haven.
  • You've made it to Twinspur Haven; there has to be something here.
  • You've found some hastily burned notes; putting them together you can barely make out the remnants of words: "Li- -ch -itt c-ve chest be-d -rone."
  • You found a chest with a massive amount of gold and notes from Hedda the Cunning; return to Lutze with this proof.
...
  • Lutze has what she needs to make the arrest. Good job, detective!
